judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the issue's explicitly specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, and `ConversationSummary`. In `validation.ts`, it allows `limit: 0` and has no upper bound of 200, violating the acceptance criterion that `limit` must be an integer 1–200 (with 0 and 201 rejected). It also failed to wire `transport.history` into `HalEngineConfig` in `src/config.ts`, failed to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, and left an internal `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the repository. Finally, it missed several acceptance tests (streaming lock bypass, end-to-end reconnect with `?sessionId=`, `history` disabled returning `UNSUPPORTED`) and logged `error.message` on store failures instead of keeping store details out of logs.
